Location: @UUID[JournalEntry.JMwTSsJAcyYdCs3m]{Salt's Bar and the Old Shipyard}
Scenes: @UUID[JournalEntry.FttkHsYSSaCpIugu.JournalEntryPage.aJxUAHXcYpRWrhmG]{A2-E03 · Salt's}

A2-E03 · Salt's. “The road dies at a shuttered shipyard, rusted cranes cut out against a slate-colored sky. Beside the gate stands a bar with a neon sign missing a letter: SAL S. Inside are scarred wooden tables, a bar counter built from the split hull of a boat, and black-and-white photos of strikes.” The sign is a “neon” light on the façade (it isn't painted: there's no text on the map). Rosa waits with her elbows on the bar and a welder on top of it (tile or token).

The barroom. Open to the mortal public until two. The bar is half the shell of a boat hull, with the bottle shelf behind it; the strike photos hang on the north and south walls. Tables, chairs, and stools are movable (tiles): a dozen Anarchs use them for cover if things break down (Combat: Rosa stops it on the second round, “Not here.”). Tavi Mercer (MEN-05) doesn't take his eyes off them.

The back room. A meeting table (the assembly votes on whether to help the coterie) and a cork board with clippings: that's where Rosa keeps her 1996 clipping (AYU-04: “if it comes up in A2-E03, let her be the one to bring it out”). It's the place for the “private” confession (to a PC, or to David if they let him stay last). The door opens onto the barroom, on the public side; another door leads to the storeroom.

The back. Bas Okonjo hides in the storeroom (kegs, the keg cooler) so Hal won't see him; the back door opens onto the shipyard yard. Hal can talk to him alone there.

The shipyard. The sliding gate closes off the road; the bar sits outside, right up against it. Inside is the head of the slipway: it lines up with the road, and from there you can see any car coming down the only road (the Anarchs' lookout). The slipway continues toward the water, to the north, off the map; the three hulls in dry dock (Salt's havens, Rosa's among them; Ray Dorsey slept there in 1996) are the shipyard exterior (t2i): regions with no destination.

Escape. Nobody holds them back: the bar door opens onto the road.

The movable furniture (25) are unlocked tiles: they can be moved, knocked over or used as a barricade.

Placed tokens. Hidden ones are revealed from the token layer; the ones that depend on how the night went say when.
